headline: Türkiye Plans Oil Cooperation with Italy's Eni
summary: Turkish Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar announced plans for oil cooperation with Italian energy company Eni, though an agreement has not yet been finalized.
why: Cross-border energy partnerships shape regional exploration rights, supply security, and corporate joint-venture opportunities in the Mediterranean.

impacts.name: Eni SpA
impacts.why: Prospective bilateral oil cooperation ventures offer future upstream exploration and production upside pending final contract terms.
